materials.summary_zh: 一位上班族讲述自己工作日的早晨：几点起床、吃什么、怎么去上班。

segments.en: My name is David, and I work in an office.
segments.zh: 我叫大卫，在一家公司上班。

segments.en: From Monday to Friday, I get up at half past six.
segments.zh: 周一到周五，我六点半起床。

segments.en: First, I take a shower and get dressed.
segments.zh: 首先，我洗个澡，穿好衣服。

segments.en: Then I have breakfast with my wife.
segments.zh: 然后我和妻子一起吃早饭。

segments.en: We usually have eggs, bread and a cup of coffee.
segments.zh: 我们通常吃鸡蛋、面包，喝一杯咖啡。

segments.en: At half past seven, I leave home.
I go to work by bus, and the trip takes thirty minutes.
segments.zh: 我坐公交车去上班，路上要三十分钟。

segments.en: I read the news on my phone on the bus.
segments.zh: 在公交车上，我用手机看新闻。

segments.en: I start work at half past eight.
On Saturdays and Sundays, I get up late!
segments.zh: 周六和周日，我起得很晚！

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I get up at half past six. half past six = 六点半。
原文：I go to work by bus.
原文：the trip takes thirty minutes。注意 thirty（30）和 thirteen（13）的区别。
原文：On Saturdays and Sundays, I get up late!

materials.summary_zh: 汤姆搬进新公寓，给朋友发消息介绍房子和周边。

segments.en: Hi Kate,
I have a new flat!
It is small, but it is very bright.
There is one bedroom, a living room and a small kitchen.
segments.zh: 有一间卧室、一个客厅和一个小厨房。

segments.en: There are two big windows in the living room.
My flat is on the third floor, and there is no lift.
There is a park near my building, so I can run in the morning.
segments.zh: 楼附近有个公园，所以我早上可以去跑步。

segments.en: There is also a supermarket across the street.
Are you free on Saturday?
Come and see it!
Tom

glossary.note_zh: 英式英语里 ground floor 是一楼，third floor 实际是四楼；这里按中文习惯译作三楼。

questions.prompt_zh: 汤姆的公寓有几间卧室？
关于这栋楼，哪一项是对的？

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：There is also a supermarket across the street.

questions.prompt_zh: 汤姆为什么写这条消息？
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾：Are you free on Saturday? Come and see it!

materials.summary_zh: 在楼道里遇到新搬来的邻居，聊住在哪一户、做什么工作。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Hi! Are you new here?

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: Yes, I am. I live in flat twelve.

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Oh, I live in flat fourteen. I'm Grace.
segments.zh: 哦，我住十四号。我是格蕾丝。

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: Nice to meet you, Grace. I'm Omar.
segments.zh: 很高兴认识你，格蕾丝。我是奥马尔。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Where are you from, Omar?

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: I'm from Egypt, but I work here now.
segments.zh: 我是埃及人，不过现在在这里工作。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: What do you do?

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: I'm a nurse. I work at the hospital on King Street.
segments.zh: 我是护士，在国王街的医院上班。

segments.speaker: Grace
segments.en: Really? My sister works there, too!
segments.zh: 真的吗？我妹妹也在那儿上班！

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.en: Small world! Have a nice day.
segments.zh: 世界真小！祝你今天愉快。

glossary.note_zh: 问职业，不是问“你在做什么”。

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：I live in flat twelve.

questions.prompt_zh: 为什么奥马尔说 Small world?
options: 格蕾丝的妹妹和他在同一家医院工作
questions.explanation_zh: 格蕾丝说 My sister works there, too!

materials.summary_zh: 在市场买水果：问价格、说要多少、付钱。

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: Good morning! Can I help you?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Yes, please. How much are the apples?

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: They're two pounds a kilo.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: OK. Can I have one kilo, please?

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: Sure. Anything else?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Are the bananas fresh?

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: Yes, they came this morning. They're one pound for six.
segments.zh: 新鲜，今天早上刚到。一英镑六根。

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Great, I'll take six, please.

segments.speaker: Seller
segments.en: That's three pounds altogether.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.en: Here you are. Thank you!

glossary.zh: 来了；到了（come 的过去式）

questions.explanation_zh: 原文：They're two pounds a kilo.
苹果 2 英镑 + 香蕉 1 英镑 = 3 英镑。原文：That's three pounds altogether.
